absent: RMP entry and RMP state field layouts and legal assigned, immutable, GPA and size combinations
Internal RMP helpers for table setup, entry lookup, dumping and clearing
Translation between RMP size encoding and architectural page levels
TDX module argument block layout and register mapping
TDMR info list construction and keyID allocation policy
SEAMCALL assembly register handling and return preservation details

findings.text: Shutdown entry is a no-op when host SNP enable is observed; otherwise it clears RMP state and requests memory reconfiguration on every CPU.

Boot-time RMP table setup requires SNP host capability with IOMMU SNP support and successful table creation, otherwise it reports not supported; success arms crash notifiers so SNP shutdown precedes dump capture.
Segment geometry derives entirely from a shift value, with size as a power of two and mask covering the offset bits.
Usable RMP address portion spans bits thirteen through fifty one inclusive.

Contiguous table discovery accepts only BIOS reserved ranges with non-zero masked base and end in ascending order, derives length from inclusive bounds, and treats the range as a single segment with recorded base and size.

Segmented table discovery requires a reserved base, treats a non-zero end as firmware anomaly, enforces advertised minimum and maximum segment shifts, and caps the table index range when hardware reports a limit.
Table type selection uses segmented handling when the enable indicator is set and contiguous handling otherwise, consulting module configuration only on CPUs with segmented support.
Lookup service reports assignment state and page level for a frame number and propagates internal lookup failures.
Page transition service requires SNP host support and a valid frame, performs a privileged smash operation for the corresponding physical page, and returns hardware status.

Direct map preparation accepts only small page levels with valid frames and full coverage for large requests; large transitions and absent or already small mappings need no work, otherwise the mapping is narrowed to small pages with failures warned.

Privileged RMP update requires SNP host support, prepares the direct mapping beforehand, tolerates overlap contention by retrying, and on durable failure records diagnostics with stack context and reports a fault.
Privatization entry assigns a frame to a guest context using supplied address space identifier, guest address, size level and immutability choice.
Sharing entry returns a frame to shared state at the requested size level.
Leak quarantine records a frame range as leaked with a warning, counts every frame, and optionally captures RMP diagnostics per frame.
Leaked page list and leak count are mutated only while holding the dedicated leaked-list spinlock.
Crash dump hook issues cache writeback on SNP hosts so that local shutdown can proceed safely.
Three low level TDX module call entries share host context but preserve progressively more return state for the caller.
Each module call marks local cache as incoherent before entry so that later kexec flushes private data, and requires preemption already disabled.
Module invocation holds preemption across each attempt and repeats solely on transient entropy shortage up to a bounded retry count.

Module failure translation reports protection fault as EOPNOTSUPP, undefined instruction as EACCES, absent module as ENODEV, and other logged failures as EIO, with extra register context for return preserving calls.
Convenience wrappers bind bounded retry and uniform error translation to each low level entry, including variants that preserve return registers and caller state.
Loader info call number is 0x8000000000000000 and install call number is 0x8000000000000001.
Loader accepts at most 1 signature page and at most 496 module pages.
Loader update scenario identifier is 1.
Loader parameter block is packed, combining small header values with a short signature address list, a reserved gap, a module count and a long module address list.
Update image begins with a packed header carrying version and integrity fields plus page counts and reserved padding, followed by variable payload bytes.
Header length constant equals the header structure size.
Supported update image version is 0x200.

Image acceptance requires exact total length match with supported version, page counts within loader limits, expected magic and zeroed reserved area; accepted images have signature and module ranges converted to physical address lists with update scenario recorded.
Loader calls serialize on a dedicated raw spinlock held across the call and are refused on platforms reporting SEAM return VMCS corruption.
Information query passes an output buffer address using a translation safe for stack memory through the serialized loader path.
Install helper forwards the parameter block address through the serialized loader path.

Coordinated update advances from start through shutdown, per CPU install, per CPU init and run update to done, moving forward only after every online CPU acknowledges the current phase with no failures; any failure halts further advance and acknowledgment counters reset on each transition.
Update phase with acknowledgment and failure counters is guarded by a raw spinlock suitable for interrupt disabled use.

Install workers observe shared phase and act once per phase, with CPU zero alone performing global shutdown and final activation while all CPUs perform install and per CPU enable, exiting on done or on any observed failure.
Per CPU enable is idempotent, ensuring global initialization precedes logical processor initialization and recording success to skip repeat work.
Global initialization executes at most once with cached outcome shared by later callers, using reserved zero attributes and distinct reporting for absent module.
Global initialization outcome and completion flag are accessed only while holding the dedicated sysinit raw spinlock.
Shutdown requires versioned handoff metadata and after success clears global and all per CPU initialization markers to permit full re initialization without locking.
Global metadata access reads one field selected by identifier and returns its data from the designated output argument.
Handoff version field identifier is 0x8900000100000000.
Version minor, major and update field identifiers are 0x0800000100000003, 0x0800000100000004 and 0x0800000100000005 respectively.
Final activation marks the module initialized only after successful update operation and version refresh, warning on unexpected version fetch failure.
Module install accepts only images with at least header length and valid loader parameters, requiring a stable online CPU set across the coordinated install on all online CPUs.
Module update exclusion is provided by disabling preemption on entry and re enabling on exit.
Module state combines initialized, one shot completion and cached result flags with per CPU readiness markers and a TDMR info list.
Guest key range uses global key with start and count values that become read only after init.
Loader and core components use distinct log prefixes and the internal call header is protected by an include guard.
Update image magic signature is TDX-BLOB.
Loader parameter reserved area spans 104 bytes and image header reserved area spans 4076 bytes.
Loader parameters always carry version zero with update scenario selected.
